about_the_game:
Full Description:

The ED2T is an additional rolling stock pack for ZDSimulator, representing the ED2T suburban and regional electric train. This version is a transitional release, created with authentic control logic and basic safety systems.

Current Features:

  • Fully working driver’s cab with a functional speedometer.

  • Temporary sound set based on the ED4M electric train, to be replaced with a fully realistic sound model in future updates.

  • Implemented ALSN train safety system.

Technical Specifications:

  • Power system: 3 kV DC

  • Maximum speed: up to 120 km/h

  • Braking: Electropneumatic and pneumatic

  • Driver’s controller: Direct-action with smooth traction adjustment

Planned Updates:

  • Complete realistic sound model (traction motors, compressor, braking system)

  • Additional cab animations and visual improvements

  • Improved traction and rheostatic braking behavior

  • Enhanced exterior and texture detailing

This DLC is suitable for daily driving sessions and for route creators who wish to expand their rolling stock library with a typical regional electric train.
